headline: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute Passes Away in Delhi
hook: Sitting Parliament member Ramrao Wadkute has died following a cardiac arrest.
what: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute has passed away in Delhi after experiencing a cardiac arrest. He hailed from Parbhani in the Marathwada area of Maharashtra. He had become a member of the upper house after being elected in April this year.
why: Following national developments helps young citizens stay informed about representatives in the Indian Parliament.

headline: Delhi Police nab 7 in ₹68 lakh investment scam
hook: A nationwide fraud duped investors through fake trading apps and WhatsApp.
what: Delhi Police arrested seven suspects across five states for running a ₹67.78 lakh investment scam. The scheme used counterfeit trading platforms and WhatsApp groups to lure victims.
why: It highlights how online investment offers can be traps, so young Indians should verify any platform before putting money in.

headline: Shift Your Money Mindset with 5 Simple Lessons
hook: Your thoughts about cash can shape your future earnings.
what: Author T. Harv Eker says financial success starts with a mindset shift. He lists five steps: take charge of your money, set bold goals, create value for others, manage and grow money wisely, and keep learning.
why: These habits can help Indian teens build stronger financial foundations early. Start by examining how you view money and set small, clear goals.

headline: i-ALERT cuts diesel use on 1,500 RTC buses
hook: New tech saves thousands of litres of fuel daily.
what: The i-ALERT system was fitted on 1,500 Ashok Leyland BS‑VI buses operated by RTC. It reduces diesel consumption by about 6,603 litres each day, amounting to roughly 1,98,090 litres a month.
why: Lower fuel use means cheaper rides and fewer emissions, helping the environment and your pocket.

headline: Kerala Samrudhi SM-82 Lottery Results Released Today
hook: Check if you’ve won the ₹1 crore top prize.
what: The Kerala State Lottery Department posted the Samrudhi SM-82 draw outcomes on 22 Nov 2026. The top prize stands at one crore rupees, with a full list of winning numbers now available.
why: Young people can verify their tickets quickly online and claim any prize before the deadline.

headline: Hundreds Hospitalised After Chowmein at Madhya Pradesh Fair
hook: A village fair snack sent over 100 kids to the hospital.
what: More than 100 children and 12 adults were taken to the Kirnapur community health centre after eating chowmein at a local fair. A total of 118 children were first admitted, and 45 of them were later moved to Balaghat district hospital for further care.
why: The incident underscores the need for strict food safety at public events, reminding young people to be careful about street food hygiene.

headline: Parishioner groups clash at Kerala church over priest's resignation
hook: A priest was locked inside his own church as factions fought.
what: At St Anne's Church in Pettah, Kerala, two factions of parishioners confronted each other over Father Theodosius D Cruz's resignation. One group locked the priest inside the presbytery on Sunday morning. Police were deployed to the site.
why: The incident shows how local disputes can spill into religious spaces and draw police involvement. Staying aware of community issues helps youths understand safety and civic response.

headline: Postal workers demand four-year cap on promotion wait
hook: Long promotion delays are pushing postal staff to quit.
what: The Federation of National Postal Organisations has asked the 8th Pay Commission to limit the service period required for promotion to four years. They say the move will tackle career stagnation, long promotion delays and existing vacancies in the Department of Posts.
why: If promotions speed up, it could improve job prospects and reduce staff shortages, affecting services teens rely on.

headline: Kerala to launch rehab and free health for Endosulfan victims
hook: Free medical care coming for those affected by toxic pesticide.
what: The state government said it will roll out a scientific rehabilitation program for people affected by Endosulfan in Kasaragod. It also promised free healthcare services for the victims.
why: Access to treatment can improve health and livelihood for many families in the region. Young people can spread the word or volunteer with local NGOs.

headline: Sony LinkBuds Clip adds 360 Audio, three modes
hook: Clip‑on earbuds now deliver immersive sound on the go
what: Sony’s LinkBuds Clip earbuds support the 360 Reality Audio format. They also provide three distinct listening modes.
why: Young listeners can enjoy richer, spatial audio for music and games, and switch modes to suit different activities.

headline: Truck-car crash in Kutch kills seven, including army families
hook: A tragic collision in Gujarat claims the lives of two soldiers and their families.
what: A car hit a truck in Gujarat's Kutch district, resulting in seven deaths. The victims were from two Uttarakhand families, comprising two serving army personnel, their spouses and three children.
why: The incident highlights road safety concerns for young Indians and the need to drive responsibly, especially when armed forces members are involved.

headline: Indian man taken into ICE custody after Texas sentence
hook: ICE steps in right after his prison term ends
what: Raghul Anandakrishnan, an Indian-origin resident, was moved from a Texas county jail to ICE custody on Nov 22. He had finished a prison term for a visual recording conviction.
why: The incident shows that immigration authorities can act after criminal convictions, so Indian nationals in the US should stay informed about legal consequences.

headline: Urban Indians Split Between Mutual Funds and Fixed Deposits
hook: Most young savers are already using digital platforms.
what: A survey of 1,212 urban adults found that 83% are saving or investing, with 80% doing it online. About 65% start investing before age 30. Mutual funds and fixed deposits are almost equally popular among them.
why: Knowing this split helps teens decide where to grow their money early, and shows digital tools are key for starting early.

headline: Membranous Nephropathy: Kidney Issue Linked to Fairness Cream Cases
hook: Your kidneys could be at risk from popular creams.
what: Membranous nephropathy is a kidney disorder that damages the filtering membranes. Recent reports in Kerala have linked several cases of this disease to the use of certain fairness creams. Health officials are outlining its symptoms, causes, diagnosis and treatment.
why: Teens using skin‑lightening products should watch for kidney‑related symptoms and consult a doctor if they appear.

headline: Police intervene as parishioners fight over priest's resignation in Thiruvananthapuram
hook: A church dispute turned chaotic, prompting police action in the capital.
what: At St Anne's Church in Thiruvananthapuram, two groups of worshippers clashed over calls for the resignation of the parish priest, Father Theodosius D Cruz. Police were called in and deployed to the scene.
why: The incident shows how tensions can flare within community spaces, urging young people to stay informed and steer clear of volatile gatherings.

headline: Undersea cable to boost internet for Andaman’s eight islands
hook: Your island’s Wi‑Fi could get a serious upgrade soon.
what: The PANI project will lay an undersea fiber‑optic cable linking eight islands of the Andaman archipelago. The network aims to improve mobile and internet services in those remote areas.
why: Better connectivity means smoother streaming, gaming and study resources for island youth, and faster alerts in crises. Keep an eye on rollout updates for when services become available.

headline: 100+ Kids Hospitalised After Chowmein at Madhya Pradesh Fair
hook: A tasty snack turned risky for over a hundred youngsters.
what: More than a hundred children were admitted to a hospital after eating chowmein at a village fair in Madhya Pradesh. The district collector went to the hospital, asked about their condition and told doctors to provide proper care.
why: It shows how important food safety is at public events. Teens should stay cautious with street food and seek help if they feel unwell.

headline: Gold falls 31%, Silver drops 64% since Jan peak
hook: Your ₹10 lakh metal stash could be worth far less now.
what: Gold has slipped about 31.5% and silver about 64.2% from their January highs as of Nov 20. Analysts point to expectations of higher US interest rates, a strong dollar and selling pressure as main drivers. Some factors like inflation worries, geopolitical tension and central‑bank purchases could still buoy gold.
why: Young investors need to watch how global cues affect precious‑metal returns and consider diversifying beyond gold and silver. Stay updated on market trends before committing more money.

headline: Spotify keeps Work‑From‑Anywhere, cuts costs and turnover
hook: Work from anywhere could be the new norm for your future job
what: Spotify has maintained its Work‑From‑Anywhere policy. The approach is said to lower office expenses and employee churn while expanding the talent pool. The company reports fewer resignations and faster hiring.
why: For Indian Gen Z, remote‑first roles may offer more job options and reduce competition for office space. Keep an eye on companies adopting flexible work models.

headline: Enable Wi‑Fi Calling on iPhone & Android in India
hook: Stay connected even without mobile signal—use Wi‑Fi calling now!
what: A guide has been released showing how to turn on Wi‑Fi Calling on iPhone and Android phones in India. It walks users through the required settings.
why: Following the guide lets you activate the feature on your device.

headline: NIA court orders production of Kochi arson suspect
hook: The suspect in the Kochi fire faces a new court order.
what: A National Investigation Agency court issued a production warrant for Ebin Paul, accused in the Kochi arson case. The warrant follows the agency’s petition to keep him in custody while probing possible terror links.
why: It highlights how serious crimes are pursued through legal channels, reminding youths to stay informed about safety and the justice system.

headline: Abolishing equity LTCG tax may lure FPIs, boost mutual funds
hook: No tax on stock gains could mean bigger returns for you.
what: The government is weighing the removal of the long‑term capital gains tax on equity. A Chartered Accountant says this could lift after‑tax returns, bring foreign portfolio investors back, and spur more household money into mutual funds.
why: Higher returns can make market investing more appealing for young savers. Watch the policy change before deciding on equity investments.

headline: Kerala Train Food Stalls Lacking Cleanliness, Few Inspectors
hook: Dirty snacks on the rails could make your journey sick.
what: Reports show food vendors on Kerala trains are serving near toilets and beside garbage bins. Only two railway food safety officers are responsible for supervising almost 200 stalls and train services. The poor hygiene has sparked concerns.
why: Unsanitary food can cause illness, especially for students traveling daily. Teens should be cautious about where they buy meals on trains and report any violations.

headline: Three cyclones hit Bay of Bengal in three weeks
hook: A rare storm streak is rattling the eastern coast.
what: The Bay of Bengal experienced three cyclones within a three‑week span. Such a concentration of storms is unusual but has occurred before.
why: Post‑monsoon cyclone activity has risen since the early 2000s, so staying updated on weather alerts is essential for safety.

headline: Delhi's AQI hits 'poor' levels, temps dip to 11.8°C
hook: Breathing in Delhi? Air quality just got worse.
what: Delhi's air quality index reached the 'poor' category, while the minimum temperature settled at 11.8°C. The highest AQI reading was 377 at IGNOU-Maidan Garhi, followed by 340 in Uttam Nagar.
why: Poor air quality can affect health, especially for students and outdoor activities. Teens should consider wearing masks and limiting prolonged exposure.

headline: Gold down 4.5%, silver down 6.6% in a day
hook: Prices of both precious metals slumped, catching shoppers off guard.
what: Gold fell to about Rs 1.21 lakh, a 4.49% drop. Silver slipped to Rs 1.47 lakh, down 6.6% in the same session. The fall came as wedding‑season shoppers were expected to boost demand.
why: Lower prices may tempt first‑time buyers, but experts advise waiting as prices could move again. Teens planning big purchases should keep an eye on the trend before deciding.

headline: Pilgrims' car hits parked truck, nine dead in Kota
hook: A family tragedy on the highway leaves many grieving.
what: A vehicle carrying devotees from Khatu Shyam temple collided with a stationary truck on a Rajasthan highway. The crash killed at least nine members of a Maharashtra family and injured several others.
why: Road safety is crucial for young travelers; always stay alert and follow traffic rules.

headline: Pak minister calls Purana Qila a tale of two rivals
hook: A Pakistani official links Delhi’s historic fort to rivalry.
what: During the SCO meeting in Delhi, Pakistan’s minister Malik said Purana Qila represents one wall and two rivals. The comment was shared by his office on X.
why: Understanding such statements helps youths grasp regional narratives that shape media and diplomatic talk. Stay informed and verify sources.

headline: Judge says son drove Mercedes without his consent, asks to keep RC
hook: A court plea could spare a family’s car registration after a crash.
what: In the Cheranalloor collision, the judge told the Ernakulam RTO that his minor son had taken the Mercedes-Benz without his permission. He asked the Motor Vehicles Department not to cancel the vehicle’s registration certificate.
why: Young drivers need parental oversight; keeping the RC avoids extra paperwork and fees. Teens should get proper consent before using family cars.

headline: Pallikkal panchayat offers Rs 500 per snake rescue
hook: Got a snake at home? The panchayat will help pay the catcher.
what: The Pallikkal local body announced it will reimburse licensed snake catchers with Rs 500 for each rescue. The move aims to reduce the cost families face when dealing with snake encounters.
why: This support can lower expenses for households in snake‑prone areas, encouraging safe removal. Residents should contact authorized catchers for assistance.

headline: No credit history isn’t a bad score – learn why
hook: Zero credit record isn’t a penalty; it’s just a blank slate.
what: People without any credit history don’t automatically get a low CIBIL rating. The piece explains the difference and its impact on loan and credit‑card approvals. It also suggests steps for first‑time borrowers to start building a credit profile.
why: Knowing this helps Gen Z avoid misconceptions when applying for loans or cards. Begin with small credit activities to create a positive record.

headline: Nine family members die after car hits parked truck in Kota
hook: A tragic crash in Kota leaves a large family grieving.
what: A cruiser carrying 15 members of the same family collided with a stationary truck in Kota, Rajasthan. The impact killed nine people.
why: Road safety remains crucial; teens should stay alert and avoid risky driving.

headline: 5,000 extra Sabarimala slots added daily till Nov 30
hook: More chances to get a virtual queue spot for the pilgrimage.
what: The Travancore Devaswom Board will release an additional 5,000 virtual‑queue positions each day at 10 a.m., continuing until 30 November. It also said no physical spot‑booking counter will be set up at Pampa.
why: This gives more pilgrims, especially young travelers, a better chance to secure a slot online, so they should check the portal early each day.

headline: Bachelor Party D'eux collects Rs 37 lakh in three days
hook: The new Malayalam rom‑com is already pulling in crowds
what: The film 'Bachelor Party D'eux', starring Naslen and Amal and directed by Neerad, earned Rs 37 lakh in its first three days of release. The figure was reported by The Times of India.
why: The strong opening shows the movie is resonating with young audiences, so teens interested in fresh regional cinema might want to catch it soon.

headline: SBI, HDFC, ICICI shut for five days Nov 23‑30
hook: Your bank may be closed—plan cash needs now!
what: The State Bank of India, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank will not operate on five designated days between 23 and 30 November. The closures apply to branches across various regions as per the RBI holiday calendar.
why: Students and workers should note the dates to avoid missed transactions or bill payments. Use digital banking or visit before or after the holidays.

headline: Over 1.63 Lakh New Voters Added to Kerala Draft Electoral Roll
hook: Fresh voter list numbers for Kerala are out with a noticeable increase!
what: The Election Commission published its Special Summary Revision draft roll on November 12, adding 1,63,318 new voters in Kerala. With this update, the state's total voter count has reached 2.73 crore. The final electoral list will be released on January 4.
why: It shows how the state's voting base is shaping up ahead of the official final list coming out in January.

headline: Muthoot Capital tops company FD rates at 8.95%
hook: Grab the best fixed‑deposit return for your savings now.
what: Muthoot Capital Services is offering an 8.95% interest rate on company fixed deposits for November 2026. Other firms like Shriram Finance and Bajaj Finance have lower rates across one‑year, three‑year and five‑year tenures.
why: Higher returns can boost your short‑term savings, so compare the available rates before locking in your money.

headline: Fujifilm’s Spectrum Tour Lights Up Bengaluru Creators
hook: Three days of hands‑on fun for vloggers and photographers.
what: The Fujifilm Spectrum tour set up three days of interactive zones in Bengaluru. Participants could try out vlogging, cinematography, street photography and portrait sessions. The event was aimed at visual creators and photography fans.
why: Young creators get a chance to test gear and learn new techniques, helping them boost their content. Look for similar events or local workshops to sharpen your skills.

headline: India loses Sundar, Akash Deep; 8 wickets down vs NZ
hook: Two key wickets fell as India fights back in the first test.
what: In the first test against New Zealand, batsmen Sundar and Akash Deep were dismissed. Their wickets left India with eight down.
why: The loss puts pressure on India's batting line‑up, making the match tense for fans. Keep following the live score for updates.

headline: Kerala health probe finds ₹7.09 cr loss in glove purchase
hook: Half the bought gloves rotted, prompting a vigilance inquiry.
what: The state health department’s internal audit showed KMSCL bought about one crore COVID‑19 gloves at high prices. Roughly fifty percent of the stock became unusable, leading to a loss of around ₹7.09 crore. The report has asked for a vigilance investigation into former GM S R Dileep Kumar.
why: Misuse of public money can affect health services that young people depend on. Stay informed and demand accountability in government spending.
